name: Lee High Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Design, layout, & custom fabrication of HVAC products. Lee High Sheet Metal carries a wide variety of sheet metal accessories to include registers, grills, R8 flex, bubble wrap, boots, round pipe & elbows, etc. Check out our stock list for more.
about:
Lee High Sheet Metal Inc was founded in 1979 in Fairfax, Virginia. The company is a woman‑owned small business certified under Virginia’s SWaM program and is led by owner Sharon Portch.

The shop specializes in the design, layout, and custom fabrication of HVAC ductwork and accessories. It stocks a full line of residential and commercial HVAC components — registers, grilles, R8 flex duct, bubble wrap, boots, round pipe, and elbows — and also produces custom items such as chase covers, flashings, angles, boxes, pans, transitions, elbows, and straight duct. Beyond standard HVAC products, the team handles a multitude of custom sheet metal work using its in‑house equipment. The facility offers same‑day turnaround on most orders and provides delivery for large jobs.

Lee High serves contractors and building owners across Northern Virginia, Washington, D.C., and Maryland. Its customer base spans residential and commercial HVAC projects, from single‑family home installations to larger commercial mechanical systems. Testimonials highlight quick turnaround on special orders such as custom washer pans and chase covers.

The company emphasizes quick, accurate, and reliable sheet metal work at competitive prices, building long‑term relationships by treating each project with urgency and care. The business was established to provide dependable, locally sourced fabrication for the region’s mechanical trade.
